clue.text: Go on about the cupola being a lucky sign

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: about means the word on goes round the outside of the next piece

parts.note: taken as written
a cupola is a dome on a roof

explanation.surface: Someone keeps talking about a church's cupola as though it promised good fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: A propitious portent or token of good fortune is called this.

clue.text: When outside is grey and oily

indicators.note: outside means the colour word stands round the other piece

parts.note: taken as written
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: A sky or substance that is dull grey and slick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When' looks like a link word, but it supplies the inserted piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something slick with grease or fat is oily.

parts.note: zero looks like the letter O
scars are marks left on the skin

explanation.surface: A harsh judge hands out prizes of nought points.
explanation.definitionFit: The Academy Awards statuettes are known by this name, so these are awards.

definitions.meaning: the converse of something is its reverse or contrary
a person's ... number, the one in the matching role on the other side

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: contrary in meaning, and the opposite number in a matching post.

definitions.meaning: aims or goals, as in 'means to an end'
brings to a close, as a verb

explanation.definitionFit: Goals are one's purposes; as a verb the word also means concludes or terminates.

definitions.meaning: a go or a crack is an attempt, so goes are attempts
chaps are ... in the skin caused by cold

explanation.definitionFit: An attempt is 'a crack at it'; chapped skin has small splits or fissures.

indicators.note: beat means the letters of heart are battered into a new order

explanation.surface: A cardiologist would rather get your heartbeat right early.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram signal 'beat' is fused onto its fodder inside the single word 'heartbeat', so the surface hides the mechanism.
explanation.definitionFit: As in 'I'd sooner stay', this word expresses preference.

indicators.note: about means the running word goes round the other piece

parts.note: a canter is a horse's easy run
one is I, and 's is IS

explanation.surface: A tin taken out of somebody's little runaround car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runabout' must be read as two words, 'run' and the container signal 'about', though the surface makes it a small car.
explanation.definitionFit: A tin or drum for storing things is a kind of container.

clue.text: Yet deals, having shuffled, in the proper way

indicators.note: shuffled, as with cards, signals that the letters of yet deals are mixed

explanation.surface: A card player deals properly, but only after shuffling the pack.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorously and calmly, as propriety requires; a fair adverbial sense.

clue.text: A prank one got away with?

definitions.text: A prank one got away with?

parts.words: A prank one got away with?
parts.note: a mischievous adventure, read as something one escaped from

explanation.definitionFit: An escapade is a reckless adventure or prank, and it sounds like escape.

clue.text: Made up for at lunchtime the day after

indicators.note: after means the day's letter follows the time piece

parts.note: lunchtime is one o'clock, so at lunchtime is at one
D is the abbreviation for day

explanation.surface: Someone compensated at lunch the day after an offence.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to atone for a wrong is to make amends for it.

clue.text: Ran off in the excitement of the storm

indicators.note: in means the shuffled piece goes inside the fuss word

parts.note: a to-do is a commotion or excitement

indicators.note: off means the letters of ran go wrong and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone fled in alarm amid the frenzy of a storm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' turns RAN into RNA, which goes into TODO.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent whirlwind, a kind of storm.

clue.text: Drive home, which is a strain

definitions.meaning: to emphasise a point forcefully
pressure or tension, mental or physical

explanation.definitionFit: Emphasise a point, or tension and pressure: both senses fit the word.

indicators.note: about means the letters of to see Mrs are turned round into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is about to call on a married woman.
explanation.walkthrough: W. Somerset Maugham was the English novelist and playwright.
explanation.definitionFit: First name: the writer was William Somerset Maugham, known by his middle name.

definitions.meaning: stretches out
in the US a spread is a ranch or farm estate

explanation.definitionFit: Stretches out; in American usage also a ranch or large farm estate.

clue.text: The pooled tips, you conclude, will be added to the pay

indicators.note: pooled tips are mixed together, so the letters of tips are mixed

parts.note: to end is to conclude

explanation.surface: Waiters are told their pooled tips will top up their wages.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixed regular salary or allowance, especially a clergyman's, is this.

definitions.meaning: healthy, in good shape
a source of water from the ground

explanation.definitionFit: Healthy and in good shape; also a shaft or source drawing water.

clue.text: Look up 'old coinage 'in and it is informative

indicators.note: in means the coin goes inside the reversed look word
in a down clue, up means the word for look is read bottom to top

parts.note: to look is to see
the ducat was an old European gold coin

explanation.surface: A coin collector's guide is instructive about old money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' signals a reversal because this is a down clue, read from the bottom upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that instructs or teaches is informative; the verb with 'it' as subject fits.

parts.note: the place where a country's land stops is its border

explanation.walkthrough: Land's End is the westernmost tip of Cornwall, England; read literally it is the edge of a country.
explanation.definitionFit: A border between countries marks where one land ends.

definitions.meaning: continues
the money made from a sale or event

explanation.definitionFit: Continues forward; also money taken in, as in takings or receipts.

definitions.meaning: a river in Devon, England
to dash or ... about

explanation.definitionFit: The Dart is a river of south-west England; also a sudden quick movement.

clue.text: Does one never get past them when reading the papers?

definitions.text: Does one never get past them when reading the papers?

parts.words: Does one never get past them when reading the papers?
parts.note: newspaper editorials, and also those ahead in a race whom one never overtakes

explanation.definitionFit: Editorials in newspapers are called by this name, as are front-runners in a race.

definitions.meaning: took one's place in a parade line
caved in or fell down

explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers take position in ranks; a roof caves in. Both are this phrasal verb.

clue.text: It's not unusual to have an area of open land

definitions.meaning: ordinary, frequently found
village green or public grassland open to all

explanation.definitionFit: Ordinary or frequent; also public grassland such as a village green.

clue.text: When the players enter, there are whispers

indicators.note: enter means the team word goes inside the other piece

parts.note: as can mean when
a side is a team of players

explanation.surface: Stage directions: as the actors come on, there is murmuring.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatre convention: lines spoken for the audience only, as if under one's breath.

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
tends means is inclined to

explanation.surface: A debater argues against what is likely.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to assert or maintain a point in argument.

parts.note: a cross is a crossbred animal, such as a mongrel

explanation.surface: Something leaps over a mixed-breed dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: from one side to the other, as in getting over a road.

clue.text: Does it reveal unhappiness about the split?

definitions.text: Does it reveal unhappiness about the split?

parts.words: Does it reveal unhappiness about the split?
parts.note: a drop shed when weeping, and a rip in fabric, spelt the same

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a drop from the eye in sorrow and a rip or rent.

definitions.meaning: a small amount, as in 'a bit'
to play idly with something

explanation.definitionFit: A small amount, as 'a touch'; and as a verb, to dally or play with idly.

clue.text: Think the pipe will be laid outside when delivered

indicators.note: laid outside means the pipe word goes round the thinking word

parts.note: a reed is a simple pipe
to deem is to think or judge

explanation.surface: A plumber judges the pipe will be laid outside when it arrives.
explanation.definitionFit: To be rescued or set free from sin or captivity is to be delivered.

definitions.meaning: to free a prisoner
the season of March, April and May

explanation.definitionFit: To free from jail; also the season of about three months after winter.

definitions.meaning: brings forward or formally makes known
gifts

explanation.definitionFit: Formally makes known or brings forward; also gifts given freely.
